name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the preceding context and the interesting fact provided. A relevant response should build logically upon the conversation and incorporate the given fact.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to invite further discussion or maintain interest in the conversation. An engaging response should prompt the other person to continue the dialogue.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is very engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response. A coherent response should be easy to understand and follow logically from the previous statements.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not coherent at all and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response. A creative response provides unique or unexpected insights or information.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative and 5 is highly creative.

name: Emotional Tone
description: Assesses the appropriateness of the emotional tone of the response in relation to the context. The tone should match the mood of the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is inappropriate tone and 5 is perfectly matched tone.
